hero.headline: Converting Cheap Energy into Global AI Power
hero.subheadline: Kenya AI Compute is a vertically integrated infrastructure asset providing high-performance computing at 40% below market rates using local green energy.

sections.title: The Next Frontier of AI Infrastructure
sections.body: The global AI revolution is facing a massive bottleneck: the scarcity of high-density data centers and the soaring cost of electricity in traditional tech hubs. Kenya AI Compute solves this by strategically locating 1MW of IT load directly at the source of power generation in Kenya. Our project is not just a data center; it is a sophisticated energy arbitrage engine. We take electricity at $0.04/kWh and convert it into high-value digital exports—computational power for LLM training, real-time inference, and decentralized AI networks. By eliminating grid fees and middleman markups, we offer a sustainable, high-margin alternative to the overcrowded data centers of Europe and the US. Our hybrid architecture, optimized for 30% GPU and 50% CPU workloads, ensures maximum utilization and consistent dollar-denominated revenue for our investors.

sections.title: Unrivaled Competitive Advantages
items: Energy Arbitrage: Direct integration with our own power plant secures a fixed $0.04/kWh rate.
DePIN Native: Seamlessly integrated with Render, Akash, io.net, and Bittensor for instant capacity utilization.
Scalable Modular Design: Deployment speed of 9-12 months from Phase 1 (300kW) to Phase 3 (3MW).
Currency Hedge: OPEX settled in local currency while revenue is strictly USD-denominated.
Green Compute: Leveraging Kenya’s status as a leader in geothermal and solar energy to reach a target PUE of 1.3-1.5.
